nodes.label: The registry carries extensions and packs; the engine comes from its own marketplace
nodes.summary: The engine plugin is installed from the engine repository's own marketplace, `cynergis-engine`; a registry carries extensions and packs of the engine and never the engine itself, and every pack names the engine as `oto@cynergis-engine`, which the registry's marketplace allows to cross.
